Primal Bite.effect: A melee attack that deals a weapon-damage component plus additional damage.

Blood Frenzy.effect: Critical strikes can generate additional Rage in Bear forms; critical strikes from Cat combo-point builders can generate an additional combo point.

Natural Instinct.effect: Increases the critical-strike damage bonus of melee abilities.

Shifting Power.effect: An activated Cat-form ability that spends mana to restore Energy, subject to its cooldown.
Shifting Power.optimal: Use when the restored Energy will fit below your cap and you have safe melee uptime to spend it. Check the mana cost and upcoming downtime first.

Improved Shifting Power.effect: Reduces the cooldown of Shifting Power.
Improved Shifting Power.optimal: Plan extra Energy recovery windows around the shorter cooldown. Avoid using Shifting Power into an Energy cap or immediately before forced downtime.

Arcane Wrath.effect: An Arcane damage cast with a cooldown. Its additional spell-damage contribution scales with maximum Mana.
Arcane Wrath.optimal: Fit the cast into a safe damage window. Its maximum-Mana scaling does not mean current Mana can be ignored; preserve resources for the remaining encounter.

Improved Fire Blast.effect: Reduces Fire Blast's cooldown. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical-strike chance of the next Fire Blast within the resulting buff window.

Improved Fireball.effect: Reduces the casting time of Fireball and Frostfire Bolt.

Heating Up.effect: Non-periodic critical strikes from Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast and Scorch grant stacking Hot Streak, reducing Pyroblast's cast time.
Heating Up.optimal: Watch the actual Hot Streak stacks and remaining duration. Use the resulting Pyroblast cast window when safe; do not assume every critical strike makes Pyroblast instant.

Dark Inspiration.effect: Temporarily increases Spirit after completing Mind Blast or the final periodic tick of Mind Flay in the pinned simulator implementation.
Dark Inspiration.optimal: Account for the Spirit window when evaluating resource sustain. Avoid clipping Mind Flay solely to chase a buff; check the remaining ticks and the mechanic first.

Flawless Execution.effect: Reduces the Energy cost of Eviscerate.
Flawless Execution.optimal: Use the lower finisher cost when planning Energy and combo points. Preserve resources for an assigned Kick and avoid finishing a target that is about to become unavailable.

Trial by Fire.effect: Increases Fire Nova damage and reduces its cooldown.
Trial by Fire.optimal: Plan Fire Nova when the active fire totem can reach useful targets. A shorter cooldown does not justify breaking crowd control or spending mana on an empty area.

Elemental Mastery.effect: An activated window that shortens Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst casts and removes Chain Lightning's cooldown in the pinned simulator implementation.

Soul Harvest.effect: A victim dying while afflicted by Drain Soul grants Soul Harvest, allowing mana regeneration during casting and increasing mana regeneration for its duration.
Soul Harvest.optimal: Consider a useful Drain Soul finish on the assigned dying target when safe. Do not abandon a higher-priority mechanic or target merely to secure the regeneration buff.

Grim Reach.effect: Increases the range of Affliction spells.

Wrack.effect: Deals periodic Shadow damage and increases damage taken from your other Shadow damage-over-time effects for its duration.

Lingering Rage.effect: Delays out-of-combat Rage decay. The pinned simulator notes that this out-of-combat behavior is not modeled.
Lingering Rage.optimal: Plan the next safe pull around retained Rage. Do not rush the group before mana and preparation are ready; this benefit cannot be judged from a stationary single-fight DPS simulation.

Furious Precision.effect: Increases the hit chance of off-hand melee attacks.
Furious Precision.optimal: Its benefit requires off-hand melee attacks and safe target uptime. Consider it with your actual hit chance and weapon setup rather than assuming a universal damage gain.

Blood Craze.effect: Regenerates a portion of total Health after being critically struck, dealing damage with Bloodthirst, or taking a sufficiently large single hit.
Blood Craze.optimal: Treat the regeneration as recovery after its listed triggers. It does not make avoidable damage worthwhile or replace a defensive before a dangerous hit.

Gore Drinker.effect: Provides healing from melee attacks after an Enrage. The pinned simulator notes this healing is not modeled.
